Status.note: The EIA-860M table for September 2026 (plant 55225, CTG1, CTG2 and STG1) lists this block as operating. It lists a planned uprate of 17 MW per turbine in 2027 or 2028, but no retirement. The Oklahoma Department of Environmental Quality permit memo from August 2021 at https://applications.deq.ok.gov/permitspublic/storedpermits/8041.pdf describes four gas turbines. The PSO 2026 resource plan at https://www.psoklahoma.com/lib/docs/community/projects/PSO_2026_IRP_Refresh_Final_Report.pdf lists Oneta as contracted capacity of 260 MW through 2031, which is a contract end and not a plant retirement.

Backup Power.note: The EIA-860M table for September 2026 lists Oneta Power LLC as an independent power producer, not as backup or emergency generation, and the 2021 permit memo at https://applications.deq.ok.gov/permitspublic/storedpermits/8041.pdf describes base-load combined cycle turbines with duct burners. So the value of no stands.

units.notes: No retirement, mothballing or sale was found. A web search showed an older sale to Argo Infrastructure Partners but no 2026 transaction, and GEM already shows Oneta Power LLC as owner.
